_note: The eight steps are from the client brief and are correct. Prose and timings are placeholders.

steps.title: Consultation
steps.description: We sit down and find out what the piece is for, who will wear it, and how often. Nothing is shown until we understand that.

steps.title: Sketch
steps.description: A drawing on paper, revised with you. We price it openly at this stage, before any work begins.

steps.title: CAD or hand-forming
steps.description: Intricate settings are modelled in CAD and shown as a render. Traditional polki and jadau work is formed by hand at the bench.

steps.title: Casting
steps.description: Wax is invested and the metal poured in our own foundry. Weight is recorded before and after.

steps.title: Stone setting
steps.description: Each stone is set by hand. Certificates are matched to the stones going into your piece, not to a batch.

steps.title: Polishing
steps.description: Finished by hand in stages. The final polish is the last thing done before inspection.

steps.title: Quality inspection
steps.description: Checked under a loupe against the drawing, weighed, hallmarked and HUID registered.

steps.title: Presentation
steps.description: Weighed, billed and packed at your table. You see exactly what goes into the box.
